verdict.rationale: The Web UI is described mainly as a view of Workflow Execution state and metadata for debugging. Equivalent programmatic access is evidenced: the Temporal Client documents starting, listing, querying, signaling and getting results of Workflow Executions, and the official CLI gives direct access to manage, monitor and debug, including batch jobs. Service Accounts and API keys support automated access. However, nothing documents that every UI action is available through the API, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 at all candidate paths, so there is no discoverable REST spec. Missing for 10: an explicit statement or documentation of full UI/API parity, a published API reference or spec (OpenAPI/gRPC) covering all UI operations, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
